title: Ask Claude about the desk
lede: Give Claude the desk guide, then ask in plain words.

slides.cap: A Claude project holds the desk guide, every how-to in one file.

steps.title: Make the project
items: On claude.ai, open Projects, then Create project. Name it "ERC Content Desk help".
Download the desk guide. In the project, add it under Project knowledge.
In the project's instructions, paste: Answer questions about the ERC Content Desk from the guide in this project. Name the page and the button. If the guide does not say, say so.

slides.cap: Every chat inside the project reads the guide.

steps.title: In the project
items: Start a chat inside the project.
Ask in plain words, for example "How do I take an item out of the next issue?" or "Why didn't my item reach the Policy Exchange?"

steps.title: No project?
items: Start any chat, attach the desk guide, and ask.

slides.cap: The project keeps the copy you added. It never updates itself.

steps.title: When a how-to changes
items: Download the desk guide again.
In the project, replace the old file under Project knowledge with it.

steps.title: When Claude cannot answer
items: Press I need help! in the top bar. It sends a note to the desk's owner.
